Based on the provided abstract, the systematic review aimed to summarize evidence on contextual determinants associated with mental health care utilization in children and adolescents across organizational, community, public policy, and macro-environmental levels. It found evidence of positive associations with ten specific contextual determinants across these levels (e.g., access to school-based health centers, urban residence, mental health parity laws, screening programs, and organizational collaboration). 

Hypothesis 3 directly and accurately captures this finding, whereas the other options describe complex future interventional proposals or speculative predictive modeling frameworks not evaluated by this review.

CHOICE: 3
